description: Full data of ONE artwork identified by pk (use a search tool first to find the pk). Always returns: pk, title, meta_description, meta_keywords (first 5), description_html (the artwork description as HTML), url (the artwork page), image_url, and "links" — up to 5 ready-to-give absolute URLs of the most useful related pages (download_page, buy_print_page, buy_oil_painting_page (only for channels on sale), student_guide_page, similar_artworks_page, preview_in_room_page). Also for every caller: "museum" - where the original is kept (pk, name, url of its page on this site, city, country), null when unknown. artwork_not_found when no such artwork is published. The result is capped at 25000 characters: when description_html had to be shortened to fit, "truncated" is true.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

pk.description: The object pk, as returned by a search tool.
